$comment: What counts as application code, per implementation, in one auditable place.
Every exclusion carries a reason. Disagree with a line here and you can re-run
Rule order is: excluded, platform, tooling, test, infra, app. A file matching
no rule is reported as UNCLASSIFIED and fails the run, so a whole directory
can never again contribute a silent zero, which an earlier version of the
The reasons array is documentation, not logic; `glob` is the matched pattern.

filelayer.note: the whole integration; the library itself is vendor code and is not counted

baseline-supabase.note: Supabase Storage + Postgres RLS; executed against PGlite

platform.why: Storage API + signed URLs Supabase provides

excluded.why: measurement artefact: the JWT-claim RBAC variant, quarantined by the baseline's own author and never loaded by the production config

test.why: tests are excluded for every implementation

baseline-raw-s3.note: raw S3/R2 presigned URLs + Postgres; executed against a SigV4-verifying local store

infra.why: bucket policy, CORS, IAM -- authored by the developer

baseline-vercel-blob.note: Vercel Blob (private store) + Postgres; NEVER EXECUTED

baseline-convex.note: Convex + the Cloudflare R2 component; NEVER EXECUTED

excluded.why: a pure-Convex-File-Storage comparison artefact written for the report, not part of the implementation
